additionalDocuments.label: Ellington Eltiera Heights official project brief

review.gallery: Nine native Eltiera Heights official renders. The tower, gallery and card are distinct from the four-tower Eltiera Views project.
review.location: Official brief page 6 marks the single tower by the pavilion. Madena supplies a separate development vicinity point. Brief page 7 supplies 15 destinations. DIFC and DXB each retain the differing estimates printed by Ellington on its site and in the brief.
review.floorPlans: 20 complete drawings, including eleven apartment and duplex plans, two retail units, five typical plates and two amenity sheets. Total areas and printed retail panels checked visually.

unavailable: Exact visitor entrance and signed unit-specific area schedules were not established.
